title: Entitlement Engineer
description:
Position : Entitlement Engineer

Duration : Long Term Contract

Location : Brazil, Chille, Colombia ,Costa Rica-LATM

Pay Range: $22/hr - $24/hr



Day to Day:

Insight Global is seeking an IAM Engineer with strong SAP GRC Access Control expertise to support identity and access governance across Tenneco / DRiV’s SAP environments. This individual will manage and enhance SAP GRC capabilities across multiple landscapes, ensure access controls meet audit and compliance standards, and partner closely with security, compliance, and business stakeholders.


Specific Responsibilities:

  • SAP GRC Administration:
  • Manage, administer, and control SAP GRC Access Control across multiple landscapes (DEV / QA / PRD)
  • GRC Configuration & Support:
  • Configure, maintain, and support SAP GRC modules, including ARA, ARM, and EAM
  • Troubleshoot workflow failures and access provisioning issues
  • Workflow & Rules Management:
  • Design, configure, and maintain BRF+ rules and MSMP workflows for access requests and approvals
  • SAP Role Management:
  • Perform SAP role design, build, maintenance, and remediation across SAP systems
  • Support user provisioning, de-provisioning, and role changes in compliance with internal controls
  • SoD & Risk Management:
  • Conduct Segregation of Duties analysis, remediation, and mitigation
  • Collaborate with business and application owners to resolve access risks
  • Audit & Compliance Support:
  • Provide access reports, logs, and audit evidence from SAP GRC
  • Partner with security, audit, and compliance teams during reviews and remediation efforts
  • Continuous Improvement:
  • Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and ongoing IAM/GRC process improvements


Qualifications :

  • Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent professional experience
  • 6–7+ years of experience in IAM Engineering roles
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP GRC Access Control (implementation and production support required)
  • Experience across multiple GRC landscapes (DEV / QA / PRD)
  • In-depth experience with the following SAP GRC modules:
  • Access Risk Analysis (ARA)
  • Access Request Management (ARM)
  • Emergency Access Management (EAM / Firefighter)
  • Strong knowledge of BRF+ rules design and MSMP workflow configuration
  • Extensive experience in SAP role design, build, remediation, and maintenance
  • Single and composite roles
  • SAP authorization concepts (SU24, roles, profiles)
  • Experience conducting Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis and remediation
  • Proven experience supporting audits and partnering with compliance teams
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
  • Experience supporting large manufacturing, automotive, or global enterprise environments


Preferred Qualifications:

  • SAP Security and/or SAP GRC certifications
  • Experience in large, global enterprise SAP environments
  • Familiarity with additional SAP platforms and modules
  • ECC, S/4HANA, Fiori Security

**Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a global operation S/4HANA. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition. Our clients are some of the world’s leading companies and the candidate will be a part of challenging projects to build and support technical solutions for their needs.



The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.



The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.



The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.



Duties and Responsibilities:


The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.


  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations



Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:


  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).



Required Certifications:


  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.



Other:


  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: SAP Tax Specialist
description:
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented SAP Procure to Pay and Record to Report Tax Specialist to join our client's team in the technology sector. In this role, you will contribute to analyzing, configuring, testing, deploying, and supporting SAP solutions, ensuring accurate localization for Brazilian and Mexican legal requirements, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to align local tax and statutory requirements with global standard processes.

  • Analyze, configure, test, deploy, and support SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions focused on PTP and RTR, especially as they relate to Procurement, Finance, and Tax processes for Brazil and Mexico.

title: Cloudbees DevOps Engineer
description:
Cloudbees DevOps Engineer – Help Shape the Future of Continuous Delivery at a Global Financial Technology Leader!


Join a mission-critical engineering organisation at the heart of one of the world’s most influential financial messaging and payments platforms. Become part of a global DevOps Engineering Services team enabling modern software delivery, automation, and orchestration across a highly complex, secure, and fast-moving technology landscape. Supporting internal engineering teams across the enterprise, you’ll contribute to a mature and rapidly expanding initiative driving CI/CD/RO adoption - powering over 100+ applications and accelerating delivery excellence for teams primarily across the United States.


This is your opportunity to work inside a global organisation transforming the way software is built, released, and operated - while collaborating with senior engineers and DevOps experts across continents.


Your Role as a Cloudbees DevOps Engineer

As a DevOps Engineer within the DevOps Engineering Services team, you’ll help deliver internal tooling, automation, and release orchestration capabilities that empower hundreds of developers and application teams.

Working in a transversal function, you’ll support the rollout and optimisation of CloudBees Release Orchestration (RO) and CI/CD best practices, ensuring smooth adoption and consistent execution across the organisation. You'll contribute to a mature programme governed by senior engineers, with clear guidance, structured delivery, and high-impact outcomes across enterprise DevOps environments.


What You’ll Do

  • Support adoption of CI/CD and RO tooling across internal DevOps teams
  • Work closely with Senior Engineers to execute release orchestration onboarding tasks
  • Assist in scaling the enterprise adoption of CloudBees RO, Jenkins, CloudBees CI/CD
  • Enable best practices for Git workflows, artefact management (Nexus), and code quality (SonarQube)
  • Support SAST/DAST integration within secure delivery pipelines
  • Provide technical support to internal teams as they adopt enterprise DevOps tooling
  • Contribute to IaC and automation efforts using Python and Ansible Automation Platform
  • Support containerisation initiatives using Docker and OpenShift/Kubernetes
  • Collaborate in an Agile, DevSecOps-driven environment to standardise delivery processes
  • Ensure accurate documentation, repeatable execution, and alignment to engineering guidelines


What You Bring

  • 4+ years of DevOps engineering experience
  • Hands-on expertise with CI/CD tooling, ideally CloudBees.
  • Hands on experience with Jenkins, Git, Nexus, SonarQube
  • Experience with SAST/DAST tools
  • Practical development experience in Java/Maven or C++
  • Exposure to infrastructure automation using Python and Ansible
  • Knowledge of containerisation: Docker, OpenShift/Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of Agile and DevSecOps principles
  • Excellent English communication skills (client teams are primarily US-based)
  • Ability to follow established engineering patterns and execute with precision

Why Join the Remobi Community

  • 100% remote B2B/freelance contracts
  • Access to a global network of top-tier engineering opportunities
  • Curated content, role alerts, and a supportive contractor community


Apply today: If you're ready to elevate software delivery excellence at scale and support a global CDRO transformation initiative - we want to hear from you!

Brazil

As a Senior Full Stack Java - React Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions. Your role will involve leading technical projects, mentoring junior engineers, and continuously improving software development practices to ensure the delivery of robust and reliable software systems.

title: Finance Analyst - Collection, Finance
description:
About Voxy


Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.


Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.


We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you’re on board, we would be happy to discuss.


You can find additional information about our values at this link (


The Impact You’ll Have at Voxy

Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.


What You’ll Be Doing:

Collections & Cash Application:

• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.

• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.

• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.

• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP&A Manager.

• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.

• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.

• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.


Credit Analysis & Risk Management:

• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.

• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.

• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.


Reporting & Analysis:

• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.

• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.

• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.

• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst.


What We’re Looking For:

• B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;

• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;

• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;

• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;

• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;

• Based anywhere in Brazil

• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish

• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.


Job Details:

• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year

• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)


In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you’ll enjoy:

• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)

• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events

• Remote friendly work policies

• Professional development budget

• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify

• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world

• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)


We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.


Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.


In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.


As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer


We are looking for a Senior Developer Data Engineer to build and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets that enable Digital and Customer Experience Applications across a global FMCG enterprise. You will work hands on with Python, PySpark, Databricks and SQL contribute to modern engineering practices using Gitbased workflows and CI/CD to support end to end delivery through Azure DevOps.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and optimize ETL ELT pipelines using Databricks, PySpark to ingest, transform and serve data for digital customer experience.
  • Build and maintain highquality performant SQL transformations and dimensional curated data layers for analytics and downstream consumption.
  • Implement best practices for Databricks engineering notebooks vs repos modular code cluster job configuration, performance tuning and cost awareness.
  • Use Python for data processing utilities validations orchestration helpers and reusable libraries.
  • Manage source control using Git with enterprise workflows across GitHub Bitbucket enforce PR reviews branching strategies and coding standards.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps automating testing packaging and deployment of data code artifacts across environments.
  • Ensure data quality and reliability through validations reconciliation, checks monitoring and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate with product app teams analysts and platform teams to translate requirements into scalable data products aligned to customer experience journeys.
  • For Senior Developer lead module level design, mentor engineers drive standards for CI/CD and code quality and own delivery for critical pipelines.


Requirements

  • Strong handson experience with: Python, PySpark, Databricks, jobs workflows, clusters repos, SQL advanced querying optimization.
  • Strong experience with Git and repository platforms, GitHub and/or Bitbucket.
  • Hands on experience implementing CI/CD for data engineering workloads.
  • Strong working experience with Azure DevOps, Boards Repos Pipelines, build release workflows.
  • English for reading, writing and verbal communication directly with foreigners.


If this sounds like the next challenge for you, apply now with an updated resume in English and we'll take it from here :)

About the Role: We are seeking a dedicated and skilled Brazilian Portuguese Interpreter & Project Coordinator to join our international team. It is a unique opportunity not only to utilize your language skills but also to grow into a project management or regional operations role.

  • Mandarin Interpretation & Translation: Provide high-quality consecutive interpretation (Mandarin ↔ Brazilian Portuguese) for board meetings, business negotiations, and technical site visits.
  • Document Management: Translate project documents, contracts, and technical specifications from Chinese to Portuguese and vice versa .

  • Operational Support: Assist HR, Finance, and Admin departments in interfacing with local entities using your bilingual skills.
  • Project Growth: Take on project management tasks as your understanding of our Chinese-Brazilian operations deepens.

  • Language Proficiency (Mandatory): Native or professional-level fluency in Mandarin Chinese (HSK 4 or equivalent) and Brazilian Portuguese. (English is a plus)
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher.
  • Experience: Proven experience in Chinese-Portuguese interpretation/translation. Candidates who have studied or worked in China are highly preferred.
  • Communication: Exceptional cross-cultural communication skills and the ability to convey complex technical concepts between Chinese and Brazilian teams.
  • Mindset: Strong sense of responsibility and willingness to work on-site (Expat/Stationed) with the Chinese team.

What We Offer (Benefits & Welfare):

  • Competitive Package: Social Insurance &Accommodation provided + Overseas Allowance.
  • Home Leave: 1-2 times per year (Total 28 days), with round-trip international airfare fully covered by the company.
  • Holidays & Gifts: Observance of Brazilian statutory holidays + Benefits for birthdays and traditional festivals (gifts, celebrations, etc.).

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação II
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro , maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina , e a Fisia , distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades:


-Monitoramento e Resposta (SOC): Atuar como ponto focal em incidentes críticos, realizando análise forense inicial e contenção de ameaças;

- Engenharia de Detecção (SIEM): Criar, tunar e otimizar regras de correlação no SIEM para reduzir falsos positivos e aumentar a visibilidade sobre ataques modernos;

- Inteligência de Ameaças (Threat Intel): Coletar e analisar IOCs (Indicadores de Comprometimento) e TTPs (Táticas, Técnicas e Procedimentos), convertendo inteligência bruta em ações de defesa proativa;

- Gestão de Vulnerabilidades: Liderar o ciclo de vida de vulnerabilidades, desde a varredura e priorização (baseada em risco e exploitability) até o acompanhamento da remediação com os times de infraestrutura e dev;

- Hunting: Realizar buscas proativas por ameaças que possam ter passado despercebidas pelos controles automáticos.


Requisitos Técnicos:

- SIEM: Experiência avançada em plataformas como Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic Security ou QRadar (criação de dashboards e KQL/SPL);

- Frameworks: Domínio do MITRE ATT&CK e NIST Incident Response;

- Threat Intel: Conhecimento em plataformas de TI (MISP, OpenCTI) e consumo de feeds de inteligência;

- Vulnerability Management: Operação de ferramentas como Tenable.

title: Product Solutions Engineer
description:
About SEW

SEW.ai leading AI platforms that empower and engage billions of customers and workforce to global Power, Water, Gas , Solar and eMobility industry. As leading #1 SEW.ai platform provide world-class Customer Experience (CX) , Workforce Experience (WX) , Payment Experience (PX) , Intelligent Experience (iX) , Business Experience (BX) and Grid Experience (GX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.


Quick Highlights

  • 420+ global clients across North America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific
  • 1,550+ employees worldwide and rapidly growing
  • Millions of end users engaged monthly across digital platforms
  • 150+ global recognitions from leading industry publications and analyst organizations

SEW is a global, innovation-driven organization that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning while building solutions that accelerate digital transformation across the Energy and Utilities sector.


Role Summary

The Product Solutions Engineer is a senior individual contributor role within the Product Solution Engineering organization responsible for bridging customer business requirements with SEW platform capabilities. This role requires strong client-facing consulting expertise, deep Energy and Utilities domain knowledge, and the ability to translate complex technical and functional concepts into scalable product-driven solutions. In this role, you will also be responsible for building and maintaining innovation mindset with deep problem-solving trusted partner relationship with SEW.ai clients, helping them understand our current and future platform / product capabilities, and supporting them through their journey for next 5-10 years.


The candidate will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to design solution architectures, lead discovery workshops, and support strategic customer engagements across global markets.


This role requires approximately 30% travel to support customer workshops, transformation engagements, and strategic solution discussions.


Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Solution Consulting

  • Lead customer-facing discovery sessions and workshops to gather business, functional, and high-level technical requirements.
  • Map customer requirements to SEW platform capabilities and recommend scalable solution architectures aligned with product standards.
  • Provide consultative guidance based on Energy and Utilities industry best practices across areas such as Digital Customer Experience, Meter-to-Cash, DER, eMobility, and Workforce transformation.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders throughout pre-sales, implementation planning, and expansion phases.
  • Project management: Leading project timelines through Agile methodologies or other frameworks with precision for successful solution implementation
  • Lead technical solution discussions during and post sales cycles, including product demonstrations tailored to customer use cases.


Product & Architecture Alignment

  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on market and customer insights.
  • Design high-level solution architectures integrating SaaS, cloud, and enterprise systems leveraging a platform first strategy.
  • Develop reusable solution frameworks, accelerators, and capability mappings.
  • Ensure alignment between customer-specific requirements and scalable product functionality.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Partner with Sales and Delivery teams to support deal closures and ensure solution readiness.
  • Coordinate across architecture, engineering, and implementation teams to ensure solution feasibility and implementation success.
  • Support Agile delivery alignment through solution documentation and technical guidance.
  • Analyze product usage metrics and customer feedback to recommend enhancements that improve adoption and platform value.


Process Optimization & Innovation

  • Drive solution engineering best practices and standardized customer-facing deliverables.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Product Engineering organization.
  • Support strategic transformation workshops and executive-level architecture discussions.


Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a client-facing Solution Engineering, Consulting, or Architecture role .
  • Trilingual (English, Portuguese, and Spanish) with professional proficiency in all three languages
  • Strong experience gathering business requirements and translating them into product and solution capabilities.
  • Experience providing industry best practice recommendations within the Energy and Utilities sector.
  • Demonstrated experience working with SaaS platforms, cloud architectures, and enterprise integrations.
  • Prior experience working with global product organizations or system integrators supporting utilities.
  • Strong understanding of digital transformation across utility domains (CIS, CX, Grid, DER, eMobility, or Field Operations).
  • Ability to work effectively as an individual contributor while influencing global cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 30% .


Preferred Technical Background

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Understanding of enterprise integration patterns and microservices architectures.
  • Working knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or C#.
  • Experience with web and mobile platforms and modern digital architecture frameworks.

title: Banco de Talentos GFT - QA Automação
description:
Banco de Talentos | QA Automação


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de QA com foco em Automação de Testes, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos desafiadores, com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e evolução contínua dos processos de testes.


Se você busca atuar em ambientes modernos de engenharia, com forte cultura de qualidade e automação, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir automações de testes (funcionais, integração, regressão, etc.);
  • Definir e implementar estratégias de testes automatizados;
  • Atuar na garantia de qualidade em aplicações web, APIs e, em alguns casos, mobile;
  • Integrar testes automatizados em pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento para garantir entregas de alta qualidade;
  • Identificar riscos, gaps de cobertura e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Contribuir com a evolução das práticas de qualidade e engenharia de testes;
  • Participar de code reviews e disseminar boas práticas de testes.


O que buscamos

  • Experiência com automação de testes (web, APIs e/ou mobile);
  • Conhecimento em linguagens como Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python ou similares;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com testes de APIs (Postman, RestAssured ou similares);
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git);
  • Vivência com integração contínua e pipelines de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de testes (pirâmide de testes, testes unitários, integração, E2E);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência com automação de testes mobile (ex: Appium) será considerada um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em testes de performance e/ou segurança é um diferencial;
  • Certificações em qualidade de software (como ISTQB) serão consideradas um diferencial.


Perfil que valorizamos

  • Olhar crítico e atenção a detalhes;
  • Pensamento analítico e foco em qualidade;
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade sobre as entregas;
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Curiosidade e interesse por novas ferramentas e práticas de testes;
  • Autonomia e organização na gestão do próprio trabalho.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior (Governança e GRC)
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente. Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

Ficou interessado(a)? Vem saber mais!


Dia a dia:

Foco: Governança, Riscos, Controles e Regulamentações

Atuar de forma estratégica no fortalecimento da governança de Segurança da Informação, assegurando aderência a regulamentações, frameworks e normas aplicáveis (LGPD, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/27002, NIST, entre outras), promovendo gestão eficaz de riscos, controles internos e conformidade regulatória em alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Governança e Compliance

  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos de Segurança da Informação.
  • Garantir aderência a frameworks como ISO 27001/27002, NIST CSF, CIS Controls e PCI DSS.
  • Apoiar e conduzir auditorias internas e externas.
  • Atuar na sustentação de certificações e avaliações regulatórias.
  • Apoiar o programa de adequação e sustentação à LGPD.
  • Apoiar na avaliação de Privacy by Design e Security by Design.


Gestão de Riscos e Controles

  • Conduzir análises de riscos de segurança (técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios).
  • Definir, implementar e monitorar controles internos de segurança.
  • Avaliar riscos de terceiros e fornecedores críticos.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento de riscos e acompanhar sua execução.
  • Manter matriz de riscos atualizada e integrada à estratégia corporativa.


Regulamentações e Normas

  • Atuar nos temas relacionados a PCI DSS.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos regulatórios (LGPD, normas contratuais).
  • Traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos e processuais aplicáveis.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na interpretação de requisitos de segurança.


Integração com Áreas Internas

  • Trabalhar em parceria com Jurídico, Compliance, Auditoria, Tecnologia, Privacidade e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar comitês de risco e segurança.
  • Contribuir com indicadores, dashboards executivos e relatórios estratégicos.


Perfil Esperado

  • Visão estratégica de segurança alinhada ao negócio.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de priorização baseada em risco.
  • Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e elevar maturidade organizacional.
  • Mentalidade colaborativa e orientada a governança preventiva.


Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC).
  • Vivência com ISO 27001/27002 e/ou NIST.
  • Experiência em auditorias e avaliação de controles.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de riscos corporativos.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações como: CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 LA/LI, PCI ISA.
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou meios de pagamento.
  • Experiência com PCI DSS
  • Experiência com ferramentas de GRC.


Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Evolução do nível de maturidade em segurança.
  • Redução de riscos críticos.
  • Aderência comprovada a PCI DSS e demais normas.
  • Redução de não conformidades em auditorias.
  • Fortalecimento da cultura de governança e controles.


Contexto de Atuação

A posição integra o White Team, com foco em governança, prevenção, controles e maturidade do programa de Segurança da Informação, atuando de forma estratégica e transversal com múltiplas áreas de negócio.

title: Search Engine Optimization Manager
description:

You’ll spend your time on SEO (including AI-driven SEO). From improving rankings on Google and LLMs to measuring campaign performance, you’ll be responsible for identifying the biggest opportunities, creating a plan, and executing quickly.

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a global operation S/4HANA. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition. Our clients are some of the world’s leading companies and the candidate will be a part of challenging projects to build and support technical solutions for their needs.



The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.



The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.



The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.



Duties and Responsibilities:


The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.


  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations



Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:


  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).



Required Certifications:


  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.



Other:


  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: Account Manager
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, people-first Account Manager who can build lasting client relationships, keep projects moving, and make sure every client feels informed, supported, and confident every step of the way.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an \"unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You'll Do


  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, managing relationships, setting expectations, and delivering excellent service at every touchpoint.
  • Translate client marketing goals into clear, actionable tasks, and coordinate with the Marketing Coordinator for execution.
  • Lead regular client meetings, share updates and deliverables, and ensure everything stays aligned with client expectations.
  • Use Jiminny to document meetings, capture key takeaways, and package notes, action items, and recordings using our meeting template.
  • Review final deliverables before submission to ensure quality, relevance, and client readiness.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and industry contacts to strengthen collaboration and drive long-term success.
  • Handle client concerns and dynamics with professionalism, composure, and emotional intelligence.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of experience in account management, client services, or a similar client-facing role.
  • Clear, confident communication skills, you can manage expectations, present deliverables, and handle tough conversations without breaking a sweat.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance multiple clients, meetings, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • A strategic mindset, you connect client goals to the bigger picture and collaborate with senior team members to get there.
  • High emotional intelligence, you read the room, stay composed under pressure, and build trust naturally.
  • Proficiency using AI tools such as Claude and Gemini to improve workflows, streamline communication, and enhance overall efficiency.
  • Copywriting experience, you can craft clear, on-brand messaging and support content needs when required.
  • Experience in a digital agency or marketing environment is a strong plus.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.


Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with project management or CRM tools.
  • Experience presenting creative or marketing work to clients.
  • Background in digital marketing, understanding what your team is building makes you a better advocate for your clients.


Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Reports to the Director of Accounts
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you're someone who genuinely loves building relationships, thrives on keeping things organized and on track, and takes pride in making clients feel like they're in the best hands, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Sr. Mainframe Developer (COBOL)
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with more than 30 years in the market, is hiring a Sr. Mainframe COBOL Developer to join an international project supporting a US client in the life insurance industry. This professional will work directly with client stakeholders in the US and collaborate with distributed teams across Brazil, Costa Rica, and the United States, contributing to the maintenance, enhancement, and migration of critical mainframe-based insurance administration systems.



Main Challenges:


  • Maintain and enhance legacy mainframe systems written in Assembler and COBOL , working with VSAM file structures
  • Support and develop applications on the Ingenium platform (COBOL/DB2)
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across multiple mainframe environments
  • Support ongoing data extraction and migration efforts toward a third-party administrator (TPA)
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure system reliability, performance, and continuity
  • Provide knowledge transfer and documentation to preserve institutional knowledge


Required Experience:


  • Strong professional experience in mainframe development experience with COBOL (critical)
  • Hands-on experience with IBM Mainframe Assembler programming on z/OS
  • Proven background in life insurance or annuities systems (policy administration, claims, or billing)
  • Experience working with VSAM file structures on mainframe environments
  • Hands-on experience with DB2 on IBM mainframe
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in legacy/production environments
  • Ability to work and communicate effectively in English with US-based client teams


Preferred Background:


  • Familiarity with Ingenium or similar insurance administration platforms
  • Experience with data migration or system conversion projects
  • Exposure to CICS Transaction Gateway and Unix environments
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Computer Engineering, or equivalent


This role is especially relevant for professionals who have worked in life insurance mainframe environments, supported legacy system modernization, and are comfortable taking ownership of a broad range of responsibilities in a direct, fast-paced team culture.
company: QAT Global | Custom Software Development & IT Staffing Solutions - US, Brazil & Costa Rica Nearshore

title: Entitlement Engineer
description:
Position : Entitlement Engineer

Duration : Long Term Contract

Location : Brazil, Chille, Colombia ,Costa Rica-LATM

Pay Range: $22/hr - $24/hr



Day to Day:

Insight Global is seeking an IAM Engineer with strong SAP GRC Access Control expertise to support identity and access governance across Tenneco / DRiV’s SAP environments. This individual will manage and enhance SAP GRC capabilities across multiple landscapes, ensure access controls meet audit and compliance standards, and partner closely with security, compliance, and business stakeholders.


Specific Responsibilities:

  • SAP GRC Administration:
  • Manage, administer, and control SAP GRC Access Control across multiple landscapes (DEV / QA / PRD)
  • GRC Configuration & Support:
  • Configure, maintain, and support SAP GRC modules, including ARA, ARM, and EAM
  • Troubleshoot workflow failures and access provisioning issues
  • Workflow & Rules Management:
  • Design, configure, and maintain BRF+ rules and MSMP workflows for access requests and approvals
  • SAP Role Management:
  • Perform SAP role design, build, maintenance, and remediation across SAP systems
  • Support user provisioning, de-provisioning, and role changes in compliance with internal controls
  • SoD & Risk Management:
  • Conduct Segregation of Duties analysis, remediation, and mitigation
  • Collaborate with business and application owners to resolve access risks
  • Audit & Compliance Support:
  • Provide access reports, logs, and audit evidence from SAP GRC
  • Partner with security, audit, and compliance teams during reviews and remediation efforts
  • Continuous Improvement:
  • Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and ongoing IAM/GRC process improvements


Qualifications :

  • Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent professional experience
  • 6–7+ years of experience in IAM Engineering roles
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP GRC Access Control (implementation and production support required)
  • Experience across multiple GRC landscapes (DEV / QA / PRD)
  • In-depth experience with the following SAP GRC modules:
  • Access Risk Analysis (ARA)
  • Access Request Management (ARM)
  • Emergency Access Management (EAM / Firefighter)
  • Strong knowledge of BRF+ rules design and MSMP workflow configuration
  • Extensive experience in SAP role design, build, remediation, and maintenance
  • Single and composite roles
  • SAP authorization concepts (SU24, roles, profiles)
  • Experience conducting Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis and remediation
  • Proven experience supporting audits and partnering with compliance teams
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
  • Experience supporting large manufacturing, automotive, or global enterprise environments


Preferred Qualifications:

  • SAP Security and/or SAP GRC certifications
  • Experience in large, global enterprise SAP environments
  • Familiarity with additional SAP platforms and modules
  • ECC, S/4HANA, Fiori Security





**Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

**Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

title: SAP Tax Specialist
description:
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented SAP Procure to Pay and Record to Report Tax Specialist to join our client's team in the technology sector. In this role, you will contribute to analyzing, configuring, testing, deploying, and supporting SAP solutions, ensuring accurate localization for Brazilian and Mexican legal requirements, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to align local tax and statutory requirements with global standard processes.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze, configure, test, deploy, and support SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions focused on PTP and RTR, especially as they relate to Procurement, Finance, and Tax processes for Brazil and Mexico.
  • Make recommendations for improving business processes and technology enablement, particularly around local tax compliance and statutory reporting.
  • Ensure accurate localization of SAP solutions to comply with Brazilian and Mexican legal and fiscal requirements.
  • Develop standard business process design, configure, test, deploy and support SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions.
  • Effectively communicate and collaborate with Procurement, Finance, Tax, IT Business Partners, and Senior Leadership.
  • Resolve integration points between RTR, Procure to Pay (PTP), Order to Cash (OTC), and Treasury processes.
  • Support daily operations for SAP Procurement, Finance, and Tax processes, including issue resolution, user support, and change management.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align local tax and statutory requirements with global standard processes.
  • Utilize technical and functional expertise to support Procurement, Finance, and Tax initiatives.
  • Participate in or lead projects implementing or upgrading tax localization and compliance solutions.

Requirements

  • Deep knowledge of procurement and financial operations, tax calculation, and compliance reporting within the Brazilian and Mexican legislative environments.
  • Experience with SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with various business stakeholders.
  • Ability to make decisions applicable to the level of influence in the organization.

title: Lead Test Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Europe - Romania, Poland, and Ukraine, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past three years and plans to continue growing.


Key responsibilities

  • Demonstrate a deep, system-level understanding of the entire product architecture to ensure comprehensive and thorough testing across all layers.
  • Proactively identify, coordinate, and manage cross-team dependencies to ensure seamless end-to-end quality and delivery.
  • Employ extensive testing experience across Native Mobile Applications, Backend services, and Front-end systems .
  • Design and execute advanced testing techniques, including thorough Monkey Testing , and champion the introduction of Chaos Engineering practices into the development pipeline.
  • Identify tasks/dependencies/risks during backlog grooming/planning.
  • Provide reasonable test estimates and feedback on priorities.
  • Fully understand and actively provide ways to improve project/solution level test strategy/test design principles.
  • Contribute to the evaluation of testing tools/techniques/strategies.
  • Contribute effectively to the development of a project's test strategy and automation suite.
  • Collaborate with developers/business analysts for feedback into software design and tests.
  • Assist with effective test reporting and contribute to ensuring the CI/CD pipeline has thorough test coverages.
  • Contribute effectively to utilize an automation framework for testing and the creation of test scripts (different automation test layers such as UI or API Acceptance Tests).
  • Identify gaps in the current automation suite and help prioritize those / get them into the backlog.
  • Investigate and assist in diagnosing issues.
  • Share testing/product knowledge with other team members.

Must have

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing, with a focus on large, complex, and distributed systems.
  • Proven experience as a coordinator or leader managing QA activities across multiple, interdependent teams and technical domains (Mobile, Web, Backend).
  • Deep expertise in various testing methodologies, including mandatory experience with Monkey Testing and/or a strong theoretical or practical background in Chaos Engineering/Resilience Testing.
  • Mandatory professional experience testing: Native Mobile Applications (iOS and/or Android), Distributed Backend/Microservices Platforms.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably AWS, and understanding of how cloud services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS) impact system testing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Professional experience in complex frontend web applications.
  • Automation is a plus; experience programming or scripting in at least one modern language (e.g., Python or Ruby).


What we offer

  • 100% remote in Poland, Romania, Ukraine, or Brazil.
  • B2B Contract.
  • English classes.

  • Planejar e garantir a execução de todas as etapas: reprodução (cobertura, inseminação artificial, diagnóstico de gestação), controle de ciclo estral, taxas de fertilidade, parto e desmame, gestão de matrizes e leitões. Maternidade , creche e terminação (manejo nutricional por fase, conversão alimentar e ganho de peso, estratégias para redução de perdas, planejamento de abate).
  • Monitorizar indicadores zootécnicos (taxa de parto, mortalidade, ganho de peso, conversão alimentar).
  • Garantir cumprimento das metas de produção e qualidade.
  • Implementar e garantir protocolos sanitários e de vacinação.
  • Controlar uso correto de medicamentos veterinários.
  • Prevenir surtos e agir rapidamente em casos de doença.
  • Assegurar cumprimentos de normas de biossegurança.
  • Liderar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe operacional.
  • Distribuir atividades e garantir disciplina operacional.
  • Acompanhar desempenho e engajamento.
  • Construir cultura de responsabilidade e cuidado.
  • Controlar custos (ração, medicamentos, mão de obra e insumos).
  • Otimizar uso de recursos e reduzir desperdícios.
  • Garantir rentabilidade da operação.
  • Reportar resultados a diretoria com indicadores.
  • Preparar granjas para auditorias e certificações.
  • Garantir bem-estar animal.
  • Atuar junto com fornecedores.

title: Senior Electrical BIM Engineer
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.


We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:

Eracore is growing in Brazil , and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U.S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.


Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Eracore

  • Competitive hourly pay
  • Continuing Education
  • Sports & Fitness
  • Fully remote work
  • Healthy work–life balance
  • Learning platforms for professional growth
  • Supportive leadership and mentorship


Your Role

  • Perform hands-on VDC and Electrical BIM production, including modeling, coordination, shop drawings, and prefabrication deliverables.
  • Ensure all work complies with design intent, NEC codes, and client requirements.
  • Take full ownership of assigned tasks and deliverables with minimal supervision.
  • Identify and resolve clashes and coordination issues and support the development of coordination-ready drawings.
  • Manage tasks, project schedules, and internal deadlines effectively.
  • Participate in client coordination meetings to align design intent, standards, and technical requirements.
  • Support RFIs and technical clarifications as required.
  • Provide technical guidance, coaching, and oversight to junior and mid-level engineers.
  • Maintain strong proficiency in Revit, Navisworks, Evolve, and other required VDC tools.


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in Electrical BIM
  • Strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus
  • Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam
  • Team-oriented mindset with mentoring experience
  • Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused
  • Spoken and technical written Intermediate English

title: DevOps Sr
description:
O Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar como DevOps, no ICC SOFT.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Realizar a atualização de sistemas (deployment) utilizando tecnologia específica do projeto;
  • Desenvolver scripts de alta complexidade para automatização de deployment do projeto ou qualquer outra tarefa que o projeto julgue necessária sua automatização;
  • Realizar monitoramento de sistemas e aplicações utilizando tecnologia definida no projeto, analisar de a alta complexidade em dados obtidos, e realizar configurações complexas na ferramenta;
  • Definir arquitetura em termos de documentação e tecnologia;
  • Utilizar plataformas de computação em nuvem e provisionar recursos e serviços básicos de cloud, de forma manual e automatizada;
  • Desenvolver ferramentas web de complexidade média para uso interno do projeto;
  • Documentar processos e soluções técnicas de acordo com as necessidades do projeto;
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes críticos de software e infraestrutura no sistema;
  • Realizar automatização de processo de Build;
  • Analisar e isolar o defeito apontado no processo de testes da solução, bem como identificar a causa raiz e propor uma solução a fim de atender aos processos de qualidade de software;
  • Criar documentações complementares de acordo com as necessidades do projeto;
  • Aplicar novos procedimentos de desenvolvimento de software, conforme necessidade, descrevendo métodos e operacionalização dos mesmos, em sequência padronizada, de acordo com o sistema de qualidade assegurada, a fim de buscar melhorias contínuas;
  • Atuar como agente multiplicador de conhecimentos, prestando suporte técnico ao time.


Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em cursos de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;


Forte compreensão de arquiteturas nativas de nuvem (cloud-native), incluindo Kubernetes, microsserviços e malha de serviços (service mesh);


Domínio em:

  • Ferramentas para deployment (ex: Jenkings, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Travis CI, Salt),
  • Plataformas de computação em nuvem (ex: AWS, Openstack, Google Cloud),
  • Criação de scripts em Shell Script, Python ou PHP,
  • Automatização de cloud (ex: Terraform, Cloud Formation),
  • Infraestrutura como Código,
  • Linguagem de programação para automatização de testes (ex: Selenium, Javascript, Phanton JS, Casper JS),
  • Ferramentas de controle de versão (Ex.:GIT, Gerrit),
  • Lógica de Programação;


Conhecimentos em:

  • Ferramentas Grafana, Graphite, ELK,
  • Utilização de container Docker, Kubernetes, Gerenciamento de ambiente Linux,
  • Banco de Dados (Ex: SQL Server, MySQL, Cassandra) SQL/NoSQL, consulta e criação de tabelas/esquemas/scripts,
  • Métodos de desenvolvimento de sistemas (Ex: Scrum) e ferramenta de controle (EX: Jira);


Noções sobre Segurança e Vulnerabilidade (Ex. SQL injection, cross-site scripting, CSRF, SSL, etc);


Inglês avançado / fluente para conversação devido contato diário com equipes internacionais.

Informações adicionais

Horário de trabalho : Segunda à sexta-feira, das 8h as 12h e das 13h00 as 17h00.


Local de trabalho : As atividades serão realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho \"Home Office\".

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Data Engineer para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.


Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Criar análises e relatórios a partir de diferentes fontes de dados, com foco em gerar insights acionáveis.
  • Construir e manter modelos de dados eficientes (camadas analíticas, camada semantica, views, data marts).
  • Trabalhar com ferramentas como DBT, SQL, Python e ambientes como BigQuery ou Redshift.
  • Criar e documentar transformações de dados com boas práticas de versionamento e testes.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados, analistas e product managers para garantir dados confiáveis.
  • Desenvolver dashboards (ex: Metabase, Looker) para visualização de métricas e KPIs.
  • Apoiar a criação de pequenos modelos preditivos ou análises estatísticas simples quando necessário.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com SQL e modelagem de dados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de transformação de dados como DBT ou equivalente.
  • Capacidade de realizar análises exploratórias e criar relatórios com storytelling.
  • Noções de Python para análises e automações básicas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de visualização de dados.
  • Mentalidade orientada a produto e negócio: entender o \"porquê\" por trás dos dados.
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de versionamento e qualidade de dados.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Experiência com Airflow ou outras ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Experiência com modelos preditivos simples (ex: churn, scoring, clustering).
  • Experiência em ambientes com DataOps ou MLOps.
  • Conhecimento em testes de dados (ex: dbt tests, Great Expectations).
  • Experiência explorando e analisando dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes, entendendo as demandas do negócio por meio de conversas com stakeholders.
  • Vivência traduzindo os resultados por meio de relatórios e dashboards em ferramentas como Looker ou Metabase.


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Ajuda de custo para o remoto;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Engenheira de Dados e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se aplique pelo LinkedIn

  • Solucionar problemas decorrentes em ambientes produtivos de maneira eficiente, reduzindo o impacto para o cliente da maneira ágil

title: Meitu Campus Ambassador (Analytics Track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship


We’re looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.

What you’ll do:

● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what’s hot, what’s not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.

● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.

● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.

● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.

We’re looking for someone who is:

● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the “why” behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.

● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.

● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.

Bonus if you have:

● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.

● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).

● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.


What You’ll Get

Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team

● Early access to product features and training sessions

● Workshops on social media, product, or design

Rewards & Credit System

We’ll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!

Redeem credits for:

● Annual Meitu products membership

● “Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador” Certificate + internship reference

● Meitu Special Deisgn

● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership

● Summer Internship Offer

● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)


About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.


Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.


At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Business Development Manager (FX/CFD) - Brazil
description:
D Prime is a globally recognized online broker, empowering professional investors with access to multi-asset CFD trading across global markets. With operational hubs in Dallas, London, Sydney, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Dubai, we combine advanced technology with deep industry expertise to deliver a seamless trading experience.   • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Experience working with CRM systems and managing sales pipelines

  • Target-driven mindset with experience working toward KPIs and revenue goals
  • Willingness to travel for partner meetings, expos, and industry events


What We Offer


  • Competitive base salary & performance-based incentives and bonuses
  • Opportunity to influence regional partnership and client acquisition strategies

  • Flexible working arrangement


If you’re a results-driven business development professional with industry experience and a passion for building strong client and partner relationships, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today.
